title: paretosecurity: 0.1.9 -> 0.2.12
reason: Applicable: real paretosecurity module + wired test. Real diff changes trayIcon's own declaration form from mkEnableOption to a plain mkOption (type=bool, default=true) -- same predicate (lib.mkIf cfg.trayIcon {...}) remains, just at a shifted line.
targets_toml: single target paretosecurity, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,paretosecurity], watch=[trayIcon].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: A real, substantive, and genuinely interesting transition -- NOT an oba gap, a real change in the underlying test. At base, check_base exits 0 cleanly: a real witnessed PASS (mkIf cfg.trayIcon {...} witnessed=True, real test evidence trayIcon=true at the 'xfce' node). At head, the SAME predicate exists (same source text, shifted from line 42 to 46 purely due to the declaration-style change above it) but resolves to TestConfigUnresolved (unwitnessed) instead. Root-caused by direct diff of the real test file: at base, node xfce set `services.paretosecurity = { enable=true; trayIcon=true; };` together; at head, the SAME node only sets `services.paretosecurity.enable = true;` -- trayIcon=true has genuinely moved to a DIFFERENT test node (not xfce) elsewhere in the same test file. This is a real test refactor in the actual nixpkgs PR, and oba correctly, honestly reports that THIS specific predicate/node combination no longer has demonstrating evidence -- a correct behavior, not a false regression, though worth understanding as a real 'evidence can genuinely disappear when a test is restructured, and the tool must not silently keep claiming a stale PASS' case. Flagging the base-side PASS per the same rule as the other real PASSes.
